hooks.name: Verify after each spec task
hooks.description: After a spec task is marked complete, makes the agent prove it: syntax check plus the full test suite, fixing anything that broke before moving on.

action.prompt: A spec task was just marked complete. Before starting the next one, run `npm run check` and then `npm test` from the repo root. If either fails, fix the cause in the code you just wrote (don't weaken or delete tests to make them pass), re-run both, and say in one line what you fixed. If both pass, say so in one line and continue.
